newsitem.title: DUBAI: Three Africans held in Dubai for witchcraft scam.
newsitem.headline: Three Africans held in Dubai for witchcraft scam.

text.p: Dubai police arrested three Cameroonian men who took money from people on the pretext that they could use witchcraft to make it grow, newspapers reported on Tuesday.
A police statement said the three had disappeared with money taken from people in the emirate under the pretence that they could multiply it through witchcraft.
It said the three men were caught red-handed by undercover agents, but did not disclose the sums involved.
Dubai police said earlier they had arrested some African nationals who claimed to be able multiply sums of money by dipping it in a magical solution.
